purpose: A P (CPL) card's LEN= is the line's length, over the model's length= (SpiceRack P8-049: ESPice kept the model's).

oracle.derivation: ngspice 44.2 .meas values (7 significant digits, so up to 2e-7 relative rounding); ngspice-45 prints the same lines. They match the deck header's two-mode closed form (odd 0.2495310 V at 5.519181 ns/m, even 0.2396393 V at 6.169803 ns/m, both times LEN=10) to every printed digit: 0 before the odd arrival at 55.19 ns, +-0.2495310 V between the arrivals, 0.4891703 and -0.0098917 V after the even one at 61.70 ns. Every sample sits on a flat plateau, so the 0.1 ns grid's interpolation adds nothing: rtol 1e-6, atol 1e-9 V. The model's 1 m reads about 0.5 and 0 V at every sample.
